messages.content:
I implemented the Task Management API per the provided architecture and rules.

What I created
- src/types.ts — Shared TypeScript interfaces and contracts exactly as specified.
- src/event-bus.ts — IEventBus implementation (EventBus).
- src/services/user-service.ts — UserService implementing IUserService with private Map store and random UUID creation.
- src/services/project-service.ts — ProjectService implementing IProjectService with its own private Map store.
- src/services/task-service.ts — TaskService implementing ITaskService with private Map store; publishes task.assigned and task.statusChanged events; enforces forward-only status transitions (todo → in-progress → done) and throws on invalid transitions.
- src/services/comment-service.ts — CommentService implementing ICommentService with private Map store; publishes comment.added event.
- src/services/notification-service.ts — NotificationService implementing INotificationService with private Map store; subscribes to events and creates notifications as specified. Subscriptions set up in constructor.
- src/router.ts — HTTP router using Node.js http module. Handles all API routes, JSON parsing, enriches comment.added events with task title / author name / assigneeId before publishing.
- src/main.ts — Entry point to start the server.
- src/demo.ts — Demo script that starts a server and exercises the full flow (create users, create project, add members, create task, assign, change status, add comment, fetch and mark notifications).
- tsconfig.json — TypeScript configuration.

Notes on constraints
- Each service is in its own file and uses its own private Map store (Exclusive Data Ownership).
- Services do not import other service files — they only import shared types and the EventBus (No cross-service imports).
- Services do not use HTTP APIs or Node HTTP types (HTTP only in router.ts and main.ts).
- TaskService enforces the forward-only state machine for statuses (todo → in-progress → done).
- No external npm packages are used in application code; only Node built-ins are imported. For compilation and running, TypeScript and @types/node were installed as dev dependencies.
- Event wiring is done in main/router: TaskService publishes task.assigned and task.statusChanged; CommentService publishes comment.added; NotificationService subscribes and creates notifications accordingly. Router enriches comment.added payload with taskTitle, authorName, and assigneeId before publishing so notifications can be created for assignees.

How to run
- Start the server: npx tsx src/main.ts
- Run the demo: npx tsx src/demo.ts (this demo script starts its own server instance on port 4000 and runs through all features, then shuts down).

Compilation
- I ran npx tsc --noEmit to ensure TypeScript compiles cleanly.

If you want any changes (e.g., stricter typing for enriched events, persistence, or additional routes), tell me which part to adjust.
